data.title: What Has Changed For indie Semiconductor Since Its 66% Fall
data.description:

For indie Semiconductor shareholders, the loss over the past year was 65.8%, including dividends. With that outcome now on the table, which early clues in the bullish and bearish forecasts about profitability, concentration in autos, or reliance on ambitious P/E assumptions deserved closer scrutiny?

The Two indie Semiconductor Stories Investors Had To Price In

The shares cost US$5.51 at the start of the period, and anyone looking at indie Semiconductor then had to weigh two very different stories built on the same set of moving parts.

On the optimistic side, the bull narrative argued that successful ADAS design wins and software licensing could support a fair value estimate of US$6.17. This was a price that reflected what those assumptions implied rather than a guaranteed outcome, and it was based on revenue growth of 24.6% and a 38.2x future P/E.

The bear narrative looked at the same business and suggested a fair value estimate of US$4, using revenue growth of 20.2% and highlighting risks such as heavy automotive concentration and potential geopolitical disruption to indie Semiconductor's supply chain.

What The Results Changed For indie Semiconductor

The iND880 and iND881 vision and AI launches, plus a US$25 million radar production order, leaned toward the optimistic indie Semiconductor case that relied on ADAS design wins and licensing. Q2 2026 revenue of US$64.0 million and a loss of US$37.1 million, with net margin at 57.9% below zero, still left profitability unproven and kept the cautious view alive. The evidence cut both ways.

The key assumption here was that design wins and acquisitions would quickly translate into healthier earnings. When you judge any similar story, line up management claims about new contracts or products against later revenue, absolute profit, and net margin, then see how fast those follow through.

What Today's indie Semiconductor Price Is Really Asking You

indie Semiconductor now trades at US$1.82, after a loss of 65.8% over the past year. The selected Narrative places its Fair Value above that level, based on confidence that vision, Edge AI and photonics programs can reshape the earnings profile.

Rather than radar alone, this view leans on iND880 and iND881 adoption, the planned ams OSRAM CMOS image sensor deal, and quantum photonics bookings. For the fall to be an opportunity rather than a warning, a buyer would need to believe those pipelines convert into stronger revenue without letting operating costs run away.

data.title: Earnings Miss: Saizeriya Co.,Ltd. Missed EPS By 9.1% And Analysts Are Revising Their Forecasts
data.description:
It's been a good week for Saizeriya Co.,Ltd. (TSE:7581) shareholders, because the company has just released its latest annual results, and the shares gained 4.3% to JP¥7,020. It looks like the results were a bit of a negative overall. While revenues of JP¥301b were in line with analyst predictions, statutory earnings were less than expected, missing estimates by 9.1% to hit JP¥225 per share. Earnings are an important time for investors, as they can track a company's performance, look at what the analysts are forecasting for next year, and see if there's been a change in sentiment towards the company. Readers will be glad to know we've aggregated the latest statutory forecasts to see whether the analysts have changed their mind on SaizeriyaLtd after the latest results.

This technology could replace computers: discover the 20 stocks are working to make quantum computing a reality.

Taking into account the latest results, the most recent consensus for SaizeriyaLtd from eleven analysts is for revenues of JP¥328.5b in 2027. If met, it would imply a notable 8.9% increase on its revenue over the past 12 months. Per-share earnings are expected to jump 21% to JP¥273. Before this earnings report, the analysts had been forecasting revenues of JP¥326.4b and earnings per share (EPS) of JP¥300 in 2027. So it looks like there's been a small decline in overall sentiment after the recent results - there's been no major change to revenue estimates, but the analysts did make a small dip in their earnings per share forecasts.

View our latest analysis for SaizeriyaLtd

The consensus price target held steady at JP¥7,990, with the analysts seemingly voting that their lower forecast earnings are not expected to lead to a lower stock price in the foreseeable future. It could also be instructive to look at the range of analyst estimates, to evaluate how different the outlier opinions are from the mean. Currently, the most bullish analyst values SaizeriyaLtd at JP¥9,300 per share, while the most bearish prices it at JP¥5,400. These price targets show that analysts do have some differing views on the business, but the estimates do not vary enough to suggest to us that some are betting on wild success or utter failure.

Of course, another way to look at these forecasts is to place them into context against the industry itself. We would highlight that SaizeriyaLtd's revenue growth is expected to slow, with the forecast 8.9% annualised growth rate until the end of 2027 being well below the historical 18% p.a. growth over the last five years. By way of comparison, the other companies in this industry with analyst coverage are forecast to grow their revenue at 6.9% annually. Even after the forecast slowdown in growth, it seems obvious that SaizeriyaLtd is also expected to grow faster than the wider industry.

The Bottom Line

The biggest concern is that the analysts reduced their earnings per share estimates, suggesting business headwinds could lay ahead for SaizeriyaLtd. Happily, there were no major changes to revenue forecasts, with the business still expected to grow faster than the wider industry. The consensus price target held steady at JP¥7,990, with the latest estimates not enough to have an impact on their price targets.

With that said, the long-term trajectory of the company's earnings is a lot more important than next year. We have estimates - from multiple SaizeriyaLtd analysts - going out to 2029, and you can see them free on our platform here.
